# Report a security vulnerability

Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Codely-Solutions/zec-private/security/advisories/new) for security issues. Include the affected version, impact and minimal reproduction steps. Keep recovery phrases, private/viewing keys and personal wallet data out of reports.

Security fixes target the [latest stable release](https://github.com/Codely-Solutions/zec-private/releases/latest). Earlier versions are unsupported.

Report ordinary bugs through [Issues](https://github.com/Codely-Solutions/zec-private/issues/new/choose).
